lane: Daily Insight: send only a mood label from the last 24 hours, never journal text
goal: Owner decision 04/11 (Admin screens spec, FeatureDaily and the recentMood context row): Daily Insight must not send journal titles or text to the model; it may send the mood label of the most recent journal entry only when that entry was written in the last 24 hours.
successCriteria: The app sends recentMood (the latest entry's mood label, only if created within 24 hours) and no longer sends recentEntries.

The server sends the model recentMood only: from the new field, or for older app builds from recentEntries moods within 24 hours; journal titles are never forwarded. The label is one line, at most 32 characters.
The trace metadata records whether a mood was sent, not the entry count or titles.
Deno test for the mood helper passes; the function passes deno check; app tests and tsc pass.
untouchedSurfaces: Daily Zodiac Pulse and the legacy Astrology report still send journal titles; tracked separately (Astrology report is to be folded into Deep read).
No SQL; prompt stays in code until the prompt_versions move.

impact.entryPoint: Home daily insight request in App.tsx and ai-daily-insight.
impact.dataWrite: No new writes; less personal data leaves the device.
impact.backendContract: Optional recentMood added; recentEntries still accepted but only moods within 24 hours are used.
impact.adminVisibility: Trace metadata shows moodSent true or false instead of recentEntryCount.
impact.privacySafety: Journal titles no longer reach the model provider for Daily Insight.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy ai-daily-insight.
